principle: gates are preregistered targets for build; where a matched baseline is not yet measured the gate is relative or marked pending, never invented as achieved

gates.rule: all training/eval sources, splits, seeds, checkpoint revisions and hashes recorded; final test not used for selection

A13/HIRA must beat or complement sparse controls: >=5 absolute points on at least 2 dynamic/relation/robustness families OR provide a reliability capability sparse cannot meet; fixed-schema accuracy alone is insufficient
opaque-label accuracy delta <=0.5 point; option order invariance exact within numerical tolerance; held-schema quality meets preregistered floor
candidate recall >=99.5% on calibration/audit when rerank budget <K; otherwise runtime must force all-K and report it; K=255 must remain numerically valid full-K
in-domain ECE <=0.05 and shifted ECE <=0.10 after held calibration, with Brier/NLL not worse than uncalibrated baseline; thresholds may be tightened, not relaxed after final eval
target OOS recall >=90% with in-scope false reject <=10% on fresh held-domain/OOS audit; if not met, autonomous mode remains disabled and system must escalate
Vietnamese score >=90% of English on paired MASSIVE intent and XNLI relation aggregates after EN-VI stage; otherwise release is English-only and labeled so
A22 is rejected if it gains <1 aggregate point over passing A13 while costing materially more; A7-FE accepted if <=8M active and within 2 points of A13 on >=5/6 semantic families while passing G4-G6
matched same-hardware comparison required; target >=3x single-decision CPU speedup vs Laya and >=5x Q=10 throughput advantage, but no speed claim until paired run exists
no model called Laya-parity unless paired preregistered vector passes quality+calibration+dynamic+highK+OOD+systems dimensions; no single aggregate score can substitute
